questions.question: Does this DPO loop require a separately trained reward model and fresh policy rollouts?
options: No. It optimizes reference-corrected preferences from the supplied pairs.
No, and a positive reference-corrected margin guarantees that the absolute chosen probability increased.
Yes, because the reference log-probability difference must be re-estimated from on-policy rollouts each step.
questions.explanation: Its data and objective differ from the learned-reward PPO loop; evaluation quality remains a separate question.
